title: GIM: Global Integrated Model

creators.name: Osiptsov, Andrei A.
creators.affiliation: JSC Sberbank of Russia; Skolkovo Institute of Science and Technology (Skoltech)

description: A year-by-year deterministic simulation of the world as 57 interacting country agents: economy and prices, climate and carbon cycle, natural resources, society and politics, interstate relations, and discrete crises with stock-flow-consistent finance. Includes history-matched ensembles validated against output, emissions, temperature and resource prices, weak-signal detection, stability analysis (Jacobian spectral radius, twin runs, 30-year fans), and a game-mechanical scenario layer. This release accompanies the model-description manuscript included under Paper/ -- an UNREFEREED PREPRINT, not peer reviewed and not published in any journal -- and carries the validation evidence behind its claims under Paper/revision/ -- the null models, ablations and benchmark scripts with their results. Russia is modelled as a single consolidated country agent, as in the manuscript.
notes: The manuscript under Paper/ is an unrefereed preprint. It has not been peer reviewed and is not published in any journal; its numbers and claims may change in revision. Cite this software record, not the manuscript.
